metcon.description:
AMRAP x 10
10 toes to bar
10 Cal AB
3 wall walks or 10m HSW

gymnastics:
Tabata 20 seconds on - 10 seconds off x 4 mins (00:00)
Copenhagan Plank on Bench
T2B Bar Progression
1-2 mins False Grip on bar - focus on Knuckles Up (24:00)
EMOM x 3 (26:00)
10 x Beat Swing
EMOM x 3 (29:00)
Jump Into Hollow/Arch x 10
EMOM x 3 (32:00)
Bigger Beat Swing - Push Down on Bar
- Put Ball between feet - Reach Long in the Arch - Dont bend the knees
EMOM x 3 (35:00)
Knees to Chest - Aggressive & Pop - pause at the top
EMOM x 3 (38:00)
Beat Swing with Straight legs - to target
Aim for height without losing tension.
the goal is to chain them together
HSW Progression
Banded Pull Aparts x 10
5 x PVC Pipe Around the world
5 mins - Handstand Kick Up 10 Reps
Beginners - Start from a Pike - Pop up with 1 foot only
Aim for soft feet onto wall
5 mins - Nose & toes to wall - Keep in a hollow
Accumulate 2 mins total
5 mins - Nose & toes Shoulder taps -
Shift Weight between hands
E2MOM - go for a max free standing hold (spotted)
5 mins Walk away from wall attempts
5 mins - HSW Attempts or stay with a prior progression

hypertrophy.reasoning: Today hammers quads, glutes, shoulders, and core; accessorize opposing pulling patterns for balance.
